notes.title: Patch Update – Weekly Leaderboards Are Here!
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey fellow ghouls[/b][/p][p]The new patch is live today and here’s what’s in it:[/p][list][*][p][b]Weekly leaderboards[/b] are in. Compete for the top spot each week.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quickplay flow rework[/b]. Groups now stay together between rounds. Solos can join games in progress.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Haunt decor is cheaper[/b]. Candy prices reduced.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New unlockables[/b]. Flamingo (Haunt) and Snowman (Riptide Reef 2).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixes[/b]. Exploits patched. Bugs squashed. Performance improved. Menus cleaned up.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quality of life[/b]. Skippable intro screens. Improved input rebinding. Better region and watermark display.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42918594/1f4fb2552a0166713495eddc949c15c1854035c6.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]Each week's leaderboard winner will get to wear the exclusive costume throughout the [i]following[/i] week. It’s not a permanent unlock, but a temporary reward that shifts to whoever holds the top spot.[/p][p]We’re also planning to award a permanent emote as a separate prize for leaderboard winners - more on that soon.[/p][p]Catch you on the leaderboard.[/p][p][b]– The Polterguys Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Polterguys – What’s New So Far!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We just wanted to take a moment to say thank you. Watching players jump into Polterguys: Possession Party, share feedback, and post their favourite moments has been incredible -  and it’s helped us shape the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42918594/5dfee495eb33bd17106faf90c3d1df45ba8f162e.jpg[/img]

[b]Here’s a look at the updates we’ve rolled out so far:[/b]

[b]🔧 Patch 1.0.2 – April 22, 2025[/b]
• Fixed several camping spots
• Added a pause button for the staging area countdown
• Resolved scoring issues

[b]🔧 Patch 1.0.3 – May 2, 2025[/b]
• Embeautification of network stats
• Random level selection option added to Custom Games
• Custom Game menu now remembers your settings between matches
• Fixed 2- and 3-star costume abilities
• Fixed level exploits
• Disabled big possessable cameras
• Fixed issues with daily quests
• Fixed UI issue when disabling abilities
• Fixed costume quest rewards
• Soda can shake bug resolved
• Improved AI pathing in Holiday Hoarders
• Fixed penguin AI
• AI now avoids oven monster in Too Many Ghouls
• Fixed clearsight issue in the furnace level

[b]🔧 Patch 1.0.4 – May 14, 2025[/b]
• Level Shuffle option added to Custom Games
• Improved AI behavior
• More fixes to level exploits
• Further costume ability fixes
• Camera tweaks on large interactable objects
• Localization updates
• Ongoing polish and stability improvements



We’ve been busy behind the scenes too - and while this post is all about what’s already live, we’ve got more improvements and features coming soon 👀

Please keep your feedback coming - it really does help. And if you’ve been enjoying the game, don’t forget to leave a review on Steam!

Thanks again for playing,

[b]The Polterguys Team[/b]

notes.title: Patch Notes – Shuffle Play, Fixes & More!
notes.content:
[b]Polterguys Update Now Live![/b]
A new patch is out for Polterguys. This one focuses on bug fixes and gameplay improvements.

[list]
[*] [b]New! - Level Shuffle[/b] option added to Custom Games - [i]as suggested by our community[/i]
[*] [b]Holiday Hoarders[/b] - improved AI pathing so the monster is less likely to land on your head
[*] More fixes to level exploits -- keep those reports coming!
[*] Improvements to Custom Game settings
[*] Several Costumes have rediscovered their Special Abilities
[*] Localization fixes
[*] Camera behavior on [b]Big Possessable Objects[/b] (like the Furnace and Dancing Knight Armor) has been improved for a smoother experience
[*] Fixed carbonation issues with soda cans
[*] Revamped the Networking Information overlay — [i]Dom wants your feedback![/i]
[/list]
Thanks for playing and for all the feedback — more updates coming soon!
